accessories-jewelry.hat: A covering worn on the head for warmth, protection, or style.
accessories-jewelry.cap: A close-fitting hat, often with a peak at the front.
accessories-jewelry.choker: A necklace that fits closely around the neck.
accessories-jewelry.chain: A series of linked metal loops worn as jewelry.
accessories-jewelry.bracelet: A decorative band worn around the wrist.
accessories-jewelry.watch: A small device worn or carried to tell the time.

coffee-shop.latte: A coffee drink made with espresso and a generous amount of steamed milk.

coffee-shop.mocha: A coffee drink made with espresso, chocolate, and milk.
coffee-shop.chai: Tea, often served in cafés as a spiced drink with milk.
coffee-shop.iced-coffee: Coffee served cold, usually over ice.
coffee-shop.smoothie: A thick drink made by blending fruit or vegetables, often with yogurt or milk.
coffee-shop.frappe: A chilled blended or shaken coffee drink; recipes vary by place.
coffee-shop.water: A clear liquid that people drink.

coffee-shop.creamer: A product added to coffee to make it lighter and creamier.
coffee-shop.stirrer: A small stick used to mix a drink.
coffee-shop.couch: A long upholstered seat for two or more people.

five-senses.pupil: The opening in the center of the eye's iris that lets light in.
five-senses.lens: The transparent structure in the eye that helps focus light.
five-senses.retina: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.
five-senses.cornea: The clear front surface of the eye.
five-senses.optic-nerve: The nerve carrying visual signals from the eye to the brain.
five-senses.sound: Something heard when vibrations reach the ears.
five-senses.cochlea: A spiral-shaped structure in the inner ear that helps convert sound into nerve signals.
five-senses.pitch: How high or low a sound is.
five-senses.volume: How loud or quiet a sound is.
five-senses.frequency: The number of times a vibration repeats each second.
five-senses.auditory-nerve: The nerve carrying hearing signals from the inner ear to the brain.
five-senses.olfactory: Relating to the sense of smell.
five-senses.aroma: A noticeable smell, often a pleasant one from food or drink.
five-senses.odor: A smell, especially one that is noticeable.
five-senses.tongue: The muscular part inside the mouth used in tasting, speaking, and swallowing.
five-senses.umami: A savory taste found in foods such as mushrooms and aged cheese.
five-senses.flavor: The combined taste and smell experienced when eating or drinking.
five-senses.pain: An unpleasant feeling caused by injury or illness.
five-senses.tickle: A feeling caused by light touches that may make someone laugh.
five-senses.itch: An uncomfortable skin sensation that makes you want to scratch.
five-senses.bright: Giving off or reflecting a lot of light.
